transports.description: Obsidian vault MCP server (stdio). Requires OBSIDIAN_VAULT_PATH.

tools.name: read_note
tools.description: Read the full content of a note in the Obsidian vault by path.

tools.name: write_note
tools.description: Create or overwrite a note at a given vault path with new content.

tools.name: append_to_note
tools.description: Append content to an existing note without overwriting it.

tools.name: search_vault
tools.description: Full-text search across all notes in the Obsidian vault.

tools.name: list_notes
tools.description: List notes in the vault, optionally filtered by directory or tag.

tools.name: get_backlinks
tools.description: Get all notes that link to a given note.

tools.name: get_tags
tools.description: Return all tags used in the vault, with occurrence counts.

tools.name: delete_note
tools.description: Delete a note from the vault (irreversible — gates through TLA confirmation).

configurableProperties.label: Obsidian Vault Path
configurableProperties.description: Absolute path to the root directory of the Obsidian vault. Example: /home/user/Notes

checks: build: npm install && npm run build
auth: vault path only — no API key, no network egress
trust.notes: Community Obsidian vault MCP server. Reads/writes local files in vault directory only. No external network calls — purely local file I/O. Suitable for personal knowledge management workflows.
trust.securityNotes: Scoped to OBSIDIAN_VAULT_PATH — server cannot traverse outside the vault root. delete_note is irreversible; gates through TLA confirmation. Vault path should not contain secrets.
